title: quiet vs standard background
rule: Visible background for dense control arrays / isolated buttons; quiet (no fill) only when a clear stack/table/grid makes the field parseable. Too many quiet controls in a small space are hard to read.
pass_when: Standard (visible background) is used for dense arrays or isolated buttons; quiet is used only where a clear stack/table/grid makes the field parseable.
fail_when: Quiet (no fill) in a dense small space, or isolated buttons with no visible field background.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Hit-target px floors; quiet as a brand default.
